description: Implementation of ProofSourceChromium class for QUIC crypto proof source, including certificate loading, proof generation, and TLS signature computation.

classes.name: ProofSourceChromium
classes.description: Implements a proof source for QUIC using Chromium's crypto, handling certificate loading, proof signing, and TLS signature generation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the proof source with certificate, key, and optional SCT files.

methods.name: GetProofInner
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic proof for a given server address, hostname, and other parameters.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a proof by calling the synchronous GetProofInner and invoking a callback.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Returns the certificate chain matching the hostname, if any.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature over input data using the private key.

methods.name: SupportedTlsSignatureAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns supported TLS signature algorithms (all allowed by BoringSSL).
